facts.about: Suzlon Energy Limited is a wind-first group spanning turbine technology/manufacturing, project development/execution, and renewable-asset O&M. It has installed 22+ GW across 17 countries; key subsidiaries include Suzlon Global Services, SE Forge, and Renom.

flags.text: Profit compounding (+3%/yr) lags sales (+41%/yr) over 3 years — margins under pressure
Operating margin expanded 4 pts in 3 years (14% → 18%)
Only 48% of 5-year profit turned into operating cash
Receivable days stretched from 72 to 137 in 3 years
Latest quarter growth (+26%) well below 3-yr trend (+41%)

business.summary: Suzlon Energy Ltd. is engaged in the wind energy sector, focusing on the sale of wind turbine generator equipment, project execution, manufacturing of forging and casting components, and providing operation and maintenance services for wind turbines.

segments.name: WTG
segments.note: Sale of equipment, components, land sub-lease, and project execution.

segments.name: Foundry & Forging
segments.note: Manufacturing of forging rings and casting articles.

segments.name: O&M services
segments.note: Operation and maintenance of wind turbine generators.

guidance.statement: WTG contribution margins are expected to remain in that 22%, 23% range for FY27.
guidance.quote: WTG contribution margins are expected to remain in that 22%, 23% range for FY27, is the belief and it should get normalized subject to some of these externalities getting normalized.

guidance.statement: I expect the same to pan out this year as well. You can say 15% plus upside of 1%.
guidance.quote: For the full year, I would say we have done 15.1% margin in the H1. With the leverage effect, with H2 being 1.5x to 1.65x of H1, more or less, I expect the same to pan out this year as well. You can say 15% plus upside of 1%.

guidance.statement: By FY31, I want to hit 40% market share.
guidance.quote: I have given my guidance that by FY31, I want to hit 40%.

guidance.statement: Annual installations are expected to cross 10 gigawatts in the near term and reach 15 gigawatts by FY31.
guidance.quote: This momentum sets the stage for a multiyear growth cycle with annual installations expected to cross 10 gigawatts in the near term and reaching 15 gigawatts by FY31.

guidance.statement: We should be able to maintain EBITDA margins between 17% to 18% plus minus 1% to 2%.
guidance.quote: My sense is that this year also, plus minus 1% to 2% from there, we should be able to maintain, also we go out and operating leverage plays out in H2, we will certainly see a better positive change to that.

guidance.statement: Capex is guided to be closer to INR700 crores plus or minus INR100 crores.
guidance.quote: So, capex, we had guided even earlier calls also closer to INR700 crores plus minus, maybe INR100 crores depending on the timing and sometimes permits and local issues.

guidance.statement: EPC share will keep increasing to 50% by FY28.
guidance.quote: We also promised that our EPC order share in our order book, EPC share will keep increasing to 50% by FY '28.

guidance.statement: Installations expected to cross 10 gigawatt in the near term and reaching 15 gigawatts in the next 5 years.
guidance.quote: This momentum sets the stage for a multiyear growth cycle with installations expected to cross 10 gigawatt in the near term and reaching 15 gigawatts in the next 5 years.

guidance.statement: Our numbers would be more or less plus/minus you can give some leeway, 8 gigawatt in '27.
guidance.quote: Our numbers would be more or less plus/minus you can give some leeway, 8 gigawatt in '27 and maybe 10 gigawatt in '28.

guidance.statement: We would have a run rate of about INR600-odd plus minus 50 going forward.
guidance.quote: We would have a run rate of about INR600-odd plus minus 50 going forward.

guidance.statement: We are firmly on track to achieve our FY '26 guidance of 60% Y-o-Y growth across key KPIs.
guidance.quote: With strong performance in the first 9 months, we are firmly on track to achieve our FY '26 guidance of 60% Y-o-Y growth across key KPIs.

guidance.statement: Each quarter our closing order book will be larger than the opening order book.
guidance.quote: Each quarter my closing -- our closing order book will be larger than the opening order book.

scorecard.promised: WTG margins expected to remain in 22% to 23% range for FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Operating margin was 15% in Sep 2026 and 16% in Jun 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Reported operating margins for Jun 2026 and Sep 2026 are 16% and 15%, falling short of guidance.

scorecard.promised: Expect 15% plus upside of 1% for full year FY27.
scorecard.delivered: H1 FY27 margins averaged 15.5% (16% in Jun 2026 and 15% in Sep 2026).
scorecard.evidence: Jun 2026 margin is 16% and Sep 2026 margin is 15%, aligning with the 15% plus 1% expectation.

scorecard.promised: Capex guided to be closer to INR700 crores plus or minus INR100 crores for FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Capital work in progress stands at ₹123 cr.
scorecard.evidence: Full year financial data is pending for Mar 2027; current CWIP is ₹123 cr.

scorecard.promised: Firmly on track to achieve FY26 guidance of 60% Y-o-Y growth across key KPIs.
scorecard.delivered: Annual revenue for Mar 2026 reached ₹16,732 cr, a 53.6% increase over Mar 2025.
scorecard.evidence: Mar 2026 annual revenue grew to ₹16,732 cr from ₹10,890 cr, slightly below the 60% target.

narrative.scoreline: Management exhibits reasonable delivery on headline annual revenue expansion, but consistent margin pressures and stretched debtor days challenge optimistic long-term claims.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Non-recurring expenses related to branding and travel will not be present in future quarters.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Operating margins compressed to 15% in Sep 2026 despite claims of temporary cost headwinds.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Order intake is not a concern; the company maintains a healthy book-to-bill ratio.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Revenue growth slowed to 26% Y-o-Y in Sep 2026, significantly trailing the 3-year trend of 41%.

bull: Practically debt-free balance sheet with borrowings at a modest ₹673 cr and net worth at ₹10,277 cr.
Annual revenue scaled strongly to ₹16,732 cr in Mar 2026 from ₹10,890 cr in Mar 2025.
Operating margins expanded by 4 percentage points over a 3-year period from 14% to 18% by Mar 2026.
bear: Debtor days have severely stretched from 72 to 137 days over the last 3 years.
Profit compounding of 3% per year severely lags sales growth of 41% per year.
Only 48% of cumulative 5-year profit has been converted into actual operating cash flow.
watch: Monitor debtor days and accounts receivable recovery speed.
Track FY27 full-year capex relative to the INR700 crores guidance.

claims.claim: Non-recurring expenses related to Suzlon 2.0 branding and travel will not be present in future quarters.
claims.quote: Between commodity and FX, 50 bps, and between non-recurring Opex, 100 bps, so you could take about 1.5%Of course, I cannot comment about commodity and FX. But for sure, the recurring will not be there in future.

claims.claim: Higher working capital is due to seasonality and preparing for higher H2 volumes, not the DevCo model.
claims.quote: I do not think there is any linkage between the DevCo model and the working capital. I think in a previous answer, I had said that there is what amount of capital that we are committing to the DevCo side. It does come in the working capital, but the intensity of working capital here is not because of DevCo, that I can assure you of.

claims.claim: The company expects a turnaround in commissioning speed over the next 18 months.
claims.quote: I think it will take another 12-18 months, more like 18-month journey, when we will start seeing even sharper commissioning on the ground. So I think I'm very confident that over the next year and a half, we'll see this turnaround.

claims.claim: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East deferred 10% to 20% of deliveries, expected to be recovered in coming quarters.
claims.quote: These disruptions deferred approximately 10% to 20% of deliveries, which is expected to be recovered in coming quarters.

claims.claim: The company is targeting a 25% CAGR for the next 5 years as part of the Suzlon 2.0 strategy.
claims.quote: In the long term, we continue to grow in line with our ambitions set up for Suzlon 2.0 at 25% CAGR for the next 5 years.

claims.claim: Suzlon expects to log in confirmed orders from repowering in India before the end of this year.
claims.quote: I think in the next 1 or 2 quarters, I should be able to come out and tell you the pilots and the orders that we already cracked -- but the team is very confident that before we end this year, we would have already logged in confirmed order book from the repowering in India first.

claims.claim: The company is transitioning to EPC contracts, which take longer to close but will show progress from June.
claims.quote: Right now, we are in advanced stage, and I think you will significantly start hearing from June itself this quarter, the EPC orders getting closed.

claims.claim: WTG margins are expected to remain stable and not materially decline in FY27.
claims.quote: WTG margins, I don't think materially can go down.

claims.claim: The company has development rights for 2.1 gigawatts, with 1,325 megawatts monetizing in the next 6 months.
claims.quote: Beyond this 775, we have 1,325 megawatt, which will completely get monetized from June onwards in the next 6 months.

claims.claim: Execution is the primary challenge due to external factors like land acquisition and grid connectivity issues.
claims.quote: The reason why the execution is getting delayed is the first of all this is until now it is 80-20. 20 is EPC and 80 is non-EPC. So we have a limited control on land.

claims.claim: Order intake is not a concern; the company maintains a healthy book-to-bill ratio of 1.9x.
claims.quote: I still maintain the statement which I have been making Sudhanshu every single quarter: order is not an issue for us.

claims.claim: The new development vertical focuses on site identification and land acquisition to accelerate future EPC execution.
claims.quote: This business unit would concentrate on two things. So because the first thing it identifies which are the potential sites over the next 5 years based on the wind data what we have.

risks.text: Contingent liabilities include claims against the company for customs, taxes, and labor matters.
Management identified impairment risks for investments in SE Forge and Renom Energy Services.
Recoverability of trade receivables is subject to significant management judgment and ECL model estimates.
Implementation of a new IT system created risks regarding data migration and financial controls.
